text: Effect Oak starts with an Actor. An Actor holds a Model: here, a rocket's fuel. It accepts Messages: Fuel and Drain. And an update turns a Model and a Message into the next Model.
speaker: am_michael

text: To draw it, write a View. It's plain React: it takes the Model, and sends Messages when you click.
speaker: am_michael

text: A rocket can't refuel in the air, or land on the pad. So an Actor can have States, and each State decides which Messages it accepts.
speaker: am_michael

text: A State can also run work while it lasts. In flight, a Lifetime burns fuel. Land, and it stops on its own. Run dry, and the rocket is Lost.
speaker: am_michael

text: One rocket is never enough. The Launch Site keeps a list of rockets in its Model, and Actor.many turns each one into its own live Actor.
speaker: am_michael

text: States decide Children too. Only a rocket in flight has boosters. They fire, separate, and they're gone.
speaker: am_michael

text: Rockets shouldn't own the weather. The Launch Site Provides Weather, and each Rocket Requires it. Leave it out, and it won't compile.
speaker: am_michael

text: Checking the sky is a Command: an Effect the update asks for, using any service it Requires. Storm? The launch is scrubbed.
speaker: am_michael

text: And it's just React, so Motion glides the rocket from the pad to the sky.
speaker: am_michael

text: Every click was a Message, and every Message is in the Log. Launch with too little fuel, and the rocket is Lost.
speaker: am_michael

text: Step back, and it floats back to the pad, animations and all. Branch off from before the launch, fuel up, and try again. Both histories, side by side.
speaker: am_michael

text: Lifetimes come in two kinds: one for the whole Instance, one for a single State. Both are optional.
speaker: am_michael

text: Commands are keyed. Launch twice, and the countdown restarts. Abort cancels it mid-count.
speaker: am_michael

text: Updates are surgical: only the View whose Actor changed renders again.
speaker: am_michael

text: The Messages alone rebuild the whole app. Replay runs no side effects. Once it's done, Lifetimes start again for whatever is live.
speaker: am_michael

text: And the Inspector maps it all: every Actor, every State, how many Instances each has, and what every Message changed.
speaker: am_michael
